gloom_wave.name: Gloom Wave
gloom_wave.description: Give the blade to the dark and let it loose in a wave. It breaks over every enemy in the room, and the dark takes an eighth of your own life for it.
gloom_wave.cast_message: {caster_name} draws the dark blade and looses a wave of shadow!
gloom_wave.hit_message: The wave breaks over {target_name} for {value} damage!

cure.name: Cure
cure.self_heal_message: A warm light closes your wounds, restoring {value} health!

fog_breath.name: Fog Breath
fog_breath.cast_message: {caster_name} exhales a rolling bank of fog!

call_colossus.name: Call Colossus
call_colossus.description: Sing the calling and a colossus rises for a moment to shake the whole room, then is gone. The calling takes a quarter of your life to make, and needs an enemy to answer to.
call_colossus.cast_message: {caster_name} sings the calling, and the ground answers...
call_colossus.hit_message: The Colossus's quake splits the ground under {target_name} for {value} damage!

bat_screech.name: Screech
bat_screech.description: A shriek that rattles the skull.

mist_breath.name: Mist Breath
mist_breath.description: A freezing wave of mist that breaks over everyone in reach.
mist_breath.cast_message: [[RED]]{caster_name} breathes out a roiling wave of freezing mist![[/]]

ember.name: Ember
ember.cast_message: {caster_name} cups her hands and breathes on a spark.
ember.hit_message: The flame leaps at {target_name} for {value} damage!
